root_cause_criterion.missing_conjunct: `buf` must not be freed manually in the `ret != 0` proxy-parse cleanup before `flb_http_client_destroy(c)` runs.
root_cause_criterion.criterion: Once `c->header_buf = buf` transfers destructor ownership of the header buffer into `c`, the proxy-parse failure cleanup must leave releasing that allocation to `flb_http_client_destroy(c)` instead of calling `flb_free(buf)` first.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable cleanup branch manually frees `buf` and then immediately calls `flb_http_client_destroy(c)`, so the destructor reaches the same header allocation through `c->header_buf` and frees it again. The fixed program removes the manual `flb_free(buf)` so only destructor ownership remains on the error path.

nodes.state: The destructor executes `flb_free(c->header_buf)` with its free argument still equal to the client header-buffer field, producing the second free when that field still aliases the allocation already released through `buf`.

edges.relation: The proxy-parse failure cleanup first frees the header buffer through local alias `buf`, and the immediately following destructor call reaches the same allocation again through `c->header_buf`.
